info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Change Management Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Covers the ChangeRequest lifecycle under /it-change-management/v1 (initiate, retrieve, update, control/submit, assess, route-for-approval, schedule, control/start, complete, rollback, control/close, control/cancel), the audit ledger, mandatory X-Tenant-Id/X-Executor auditing, RFC 7807 error_code assertions (400/404/409) and W3C traceparent correlation. Exercises the STANDARD (pre-approved) path end to end; NORMAL/EMERGENCY CAB/ECAB routing and the operation-window scheduling collision are covered live by a dedicated cross-service smoke script instead, since both need a real ApprovalPolicy/window pre-provisioned on their owning services. Requires an organisationId environment variable populated from the Party Reference Data Directory Service Domain.
